regions.today: Sunny and warm in most areas this evening.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with mostly clear skies. Lowest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in light, occasionally moderate, north to northeast breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Sunday, will be a dry and mostly sunny day. Warm or very warm with highest temperatures of 23 to 27 degrees. It'll be a little cooler by the east coast, due to an onshore moderate, occasionally fresh, easterly wind.
